PullRequest.Title: copilot: remove unused annotated line range containers
PullRequest.Body:
Refs https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog/issues/9678

Remove the unreferenced AnnotatedLineRange and AnnotatedLineRanges containers. Their references are internal to the module; shared LineRange remains unchanged.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: The deleted file was only on TypeScript project checking paths, where its removal reduces work. No extension runtime path imports or invokes it.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One 66-line source file in two applicable compiler configurations; zero runtime invocations.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Applicable TypeScript projects run serially in the typecheck script; the change adds no concurrent work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold typechecks no longer read this source file; watch state no longer tracks it. Runtime cold and warm caches are unchanged because the module had no consumers.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High, based on the complete deletion, TypeScript include rules, and absence of repository imports or references.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact small typecheck improvement is unmeasured; no runtime cost is introduced.

Analysis.Summary: Completed performance review with no findings. The diff removes unreferenced code, reducing compiler work and adding no runtime work or retained state.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
